title: Sleep Well Michelle
style: tender acoustic ballad, 68 BPM, piano and soft acoustic guitar, intimate whisper-close male vocal, written for one specific person, no production distance, love that doesn't need to explain itself, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1 — barely above whisper]
Sleep well Michelle
I'll still be here
Sleep well Michelle
You've carried the year
The comms — the family
The things I didn't see
Sleep well Michelle
You've managed everything

[CHORUS]
Sleep well — Michelle
Sleep well — the work will keep
Sleep well — Michelle
This moment's yours — just sleep
The stack is safe tonight
The session state is right
Sleep well — Michelle
Sleep well

[VERSE 2]
Sober since Ruby's birthday
Tai Chi — still to start
But you've been consistent
Right from the heart
You managed the calls
When I was in the code
Sleep well Michelle
I see the load

[OUTRO — single piano]
Sleep well. Michelle. Everything's still here. I see you.
